what: Above the list, a square preview window (13vw) sticks to the cursor center and follows late over .6s power3. When you hover a row, that row’s image enters the window. Moving to a lower row, the new image rises from 100% below and the previous one exits upward, and moving to an upper row does the reverse (.5s power2.inOut). When entering the list the window grows from 0 to 1x over .6s (cubic-bezier(.65,.1,0,1)), the first image appears right away without pushing, and when leaving a row the image exits upward

options.follow: Length (sec) for the window to follow the cursor, default .6
options.dur: Duration of the image push swap (sec), default .5
options.x: Horizontal position (0~1) where the window sits within the list width — if given, it follows only vertically (Brand .3). If absent, it follows the cursor horizontally too
options.--fx-ratio: Window aspect ratio (css variable), default 1 — Brand 1 / 1.25

(If there is no image, show the row’s data-label text)
note: The window attaches to body (so a parent’s transform doesn’t break it) and is removed when detached. Not attached on touch devices

index.html .lp-news — original globalLatestOverview: the window follows vertically only (quickTo y .5s power4), on each row a new photo covers from 100% below in .6s expo.inOut while the previous photo stays (up to 20), on .2s · off .3s. To use this as a part, follow: .5; dur: .6; ease: close to expo.inOut

With this motion part: x: .3 · --fx-size: 15rem · --fx-ratio: 1 / 1.25
